source_caption:
Sean Bean literally climbed mountains to play Boromir⁣! 👀
⁣
During the filming of 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐑𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐬, Sean Bean went to extraordinary lengths due to his fear of flying. For the scene in which the Fellowship attempts to cross the Pass of Caradhras, the cast and crew were transported by helicopter to a remote location high in the mountains of New Zealand. Sean, however, would wake up hours earlier, put on his full Boromir costume and hike up the mountain himself.⁣
⁣
His fellow cast members reportedly watched from their helicopters as Sean, fully dressed as Boromir, made his way up the mountainside on foot.

@memento.mundus is dropping a LOTR shirt 👀 follow for more.
